answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware root of trust: the agent runs inside a trusted execution enclave that issues one unique attestation key per physical device, like a single vertex where many paths meet. A registry admits only identities carrying a fresh, vendor-signed attestation, and the enclave signs every action, so a Sybil operator cannot clone an identity without buying another machine. Honest agents pass once and keep working, while a grove of fakes withers because each copy demands real silicon and cost — a sonnet where forgery scales only with hardware, not code.
